title: Perfect!
body: I have had the free version for 12 days now and guess what. My Streak is 12 days! 💪 i have tried many a habit tracker before, nothing worked… the Home Screen Widget is absolutely beautiful and it reminds and motivates me. The app is ad free and NEVER asks to upgrade to pro. The pro version is also very reasonably priced with no subscription. I will definitely upgrade once i am ready to add more habits. Shout out to the developer, we need more apps like this one 🙌🙌
author: Neyghey
